name: dog
clue: I am a good pet. I say "woof woof".
clue3: I wag my tail when I am happy. I like bones.

name: cat
clue: I am a pet. I say "meow". I like milk and fish.
clue3: I purr when you pet me. I have whiskers and I chase mice.

name: tiger
clue: I am a big orange cat with black stripes.
clue3: I am the biggest wild cat. I live in the jungle.

name: leopard
clue: I am a fast cat with spots. I can climb trees.
clue3: I hide in trees. My fur is yellow with black spots.

name: horse
clue: I run fast. People can ride on my back.
clue3: I eat hay. I say "neigh".

name: cow
clue: I live on a farm. I give you milk. I say "moo".
clue3: I am black and white. I eat grass all day.

name: water buffalo
clue: I am big and strong. I help farmers in the rice field.
clue3: I love to lie in mud. I have big curved horns.

name: pig
clue: I am pink and I love mud. I say "oink".
clue3: I have a curly tail. I live on a farm.

name: sheep
clue: I have soft white wool. I say "baa".
clue3: People cut my wool to make sweaters.

name: goat
clue: I have horns and a beard. I like to climb.
clue3: I say "maa". I eat almost everything.

name: camel
clue: I live in the desert. I have a hump on my back.
clue3: I can walk for many days without water.

name: llama
clue: I have a long neck and soft fur. I live in the mountains.
clue3: I look like a small camel without a hump.

name: giraffe
clue: I am the tallest animal. I have a very long neck.
clue3: I have spots and I eat leaves from tall trees.

name: elephant
clue: I am very big. I have a long trunk and big ears.
clue3: I am grey. I spray water on my back with my nose.

name: rhinoceros
clue: I am big and grey. I have a horn on my nose.
clue3: I have thick grey skin and one or two horns.

name: hippopotamus
clue: I am big and I love to stay in the river.
clue3: My name means "river horse". I open my mouth very wide.

name: rabbit
clue: I have long ears. I hop and I love carrots.
clue3: I have a fluffy round tail. I live in a hole.

name: squirrel
clue: I have a big fluffy tail. I love nuts.
clue3: I climb trees fast and hide nuts for winter.

name: bat
clue: I fly at night. I sleep upside down.
clue3: I hang in caves. I use sound to find my way.

name: skunk
clue: I am black and white. I can make a bad smell.
clue3: I have a white stripe on my back. Do not scare me!

name: kangaroo
clue: I jump very high. My baby lives in my pocket.
clue3: I live in Australia. I have a big strong tail.

name: turkey
clue: I am a big bird with a big round tail.
clue3: I say "gobble gobble".

name: rooster
clue: I wake you up in the morning. I say "cock-a-doodle-doo".
clue3: I have a red comb on my head. I am a daddy chicken.

name: bird
clue: I have wings and feathers. I can fly and sing.
clue3: I build a nest in a tree. I say "tweet tweet".

name: penguin
clue: I am a bird but I cannot fly. I swim in cold water.
clue3: I am black and white. I waddle on the ice.

name: eagle
clue: I am a big bird. I fly very high in the sky.
clue3: I have strong claws. I catch fish from the river.

name: duck
clue: I swim in the pond. I say "quack quack".
clue3: I have webbed feet and a flat orange beak.

name: swan
clue: I am a white bird with a long neck. I swim on the lake.
clue3: My babies are called cygnets. I am white and graceful.

name: flamingo
clue: I am a pink bird. I stand on one leg.
clue3: I eat shrimp and that makes me pink.

name: peacock
clue: I have a beautiful big tail with many colors.
clue3: I open my blue and green tail like a big fan.

name: parrot
clue: I am a colorful bird. I can copy your words.
clue3: I am red, green, and blue. I can say "hello!"

name: crocodile
clue: I live in the river. I have a long mouth and many teeth.
clue3: I am green with bumpy skin. I hide in the water.

name: turtle
clue: I walk slowly. I carry my house on my back.
clue3: I can hide my head in my shell.

name: lizard
clue: I am small and green. I like to sit in the sun.
clue3: I can lose my tail and grow a new one.

name: snake
clue: I have no legs. I move on my belly. I say "hiss".
clue3: I am long and I change my skin.

name: whale
clue: I am the biggest animal in the sea.
clue3: I blow water from the top of my head. I am not a fish.

name: dolphin
clue: I am smart and friendly. I jump out of the sea.
clue3: I click and whistle. I am grey and I love to play.

name: fish
clue: I live in water. I swim with my fins.
clue3: I breathe with gills. I live in a bowl or in the ocean.

name: shark
clue: I am a big fish with sharp teeth.
clue3: I have a fin on my back. Other fish are scared of me.

name: snail
clue: I am very slow. I carry a shell on my back.
clue3: I leave a slimy trail behind me.

name: butterfly
clue: I have beautiful wings. I was a caterpillar before.
clue3: I fly from flower to flower. My wings are colorful.

name: ant
clue: I am very small but very strong. I live with many friends.
clue3: I carry food that is bigger than me.

name: bee
clue: I am yellow and black. I make honey. I say "buzz".
clue3: I live in a hive. I can sting you.

name: crab
clue: I live on the beach. I walk sideways.
clue3: I have two claws and I hide under rocks on the beach.

name: shrimp
clue: I am small and live in the sea. I turn pink when cooked.
clue3: I am very small and pink. I have long feelers.

name: jellyfish
clue: I live in the sea. I am soft and I have long arms.
clue3: I look like an umbrella. Do not touch me, I sting!

name: goose
clue: I am a big bird. I say "honk honk".
clue3: I am white or grey. I walk in a line with my friends.

name: deer
clue: I live in the forest. I have antlers on my head.
clue3: My baby is called a fawn. I run fast in the forest.

name: zebra
clue: I look like a horse with black and white stripes.
clue3: I live in Africa. I eat grass with my friends.

name: mammoth
clue: I lived a long time ago. I was big and hairy.
clue3: I look like an elephant with long fur and long tusks.

name: bison
clue: I am big and hairy. I have short horns.
clue3: I live in big groups on the grassland in America.

name: beetle
clue: I am a small insect with a hard, shiny shell.
clue3: I have six legs and hard wings.

name: worm
clue: I am long and thin. I live in the soil.
clue3: I am pink and wiggly. Birds like to eat me.

name: cricket
clue: I am a green insect. I jump and chirp at night.
clue3: I rub my legs to make music at night.

name: badger
clue: I dig holes in the ground. I have stripes on my head.
clue3: I am grey, black, and white. I sleep in the day.

name: ladybug
clue: I am a small red insect with black dots.
clue3: I am a lucky bug. I sit on leaves and eat tiny bugs.

name: spider
clue: I have eight legs. I make a web.
clue3: I catch flies in my sticky home.

name: mouse
clue: I am small and grey. I love cheese. I say "squeak".
clue3: I have a long thin tail and round ears.

name: hedgehog
clue: I am small and I have spikes on my back.
clue3: I roll into a ball when I am scared.

name: lobster
clue: I live in the sea. I have two big claws.
clue3: I am red when cooked. I live on the sea floor.

name: apple
clue: I am red and round. I grow on a tree.
clue3: Teachers like me. People make juice and pie from me.

name: green apple
clue: I am green, sour, and crunchy. I grow on a tree.
clue3: I am round with a stem on top. My color is like grass.

name: pear
clue: I am green. My shape is like a bell.
clue3: I am fat at the bottom and thin at the top.

name: orange
clue: I am round and full of sweet juice. My name is also a color.
clue3: You can peel me. I have juicy pieces inside.

name: lemon
clue: I am yellow and very sour.
clue3: People put me in tea. I make your face go "Ooh!"

name: banana
clue: I am long and yellow. Monkeys love me.
clue3: You peel my yellow skin. I grow in bunches.

name: watermelon
clue: I am green outside and red inside. I have black seeds.
clue3: I am very big and heavy. I am juicy on hot days.

name: grapes
clue: We are small and round. We grow together in a bunch.
clue3: We can be green or purple. Dried, we become raisins.

name: strawberry
clue: I am red with tiny seeds on my skin.
clue3: I am shaped like a heart. I have green leaves on top.

name: blueberries
clue: We are small and blue. We are sweet.
clue3: We are tiny and round. People put us in muffins.

name: melon
clue: I am big and round. I am green and sweet inside.
clue3: I am round. My skin has a pattern like a net.

name: cherries
clue: We are small and red. We have long stems.
clue3: We come in pairs. We sit on top of cakes.

name: peach
clue: I am soft and fuzzy. I am pink and orange.
clue3: I have a big hard seed. My skin feels soft like velvet.

name: mango
clue: I am sweet and yellow inside. I have a big seed.
clue3: I am juicy and orange inside. I am very popular in summer.

name: pineapple
clue: I have a spiky skin and green leaves on top.
clue3: I am yellow inside and very juicy. I wear a green crown.

name: coconut
clue: I am brown and hard. I have water inside.
clue3: I grow on a palm tree at the beach.

name: kiwi
clue: I am brown and hairy outside. I am green inside.
clue3: I am small and shaped like an egg. I have tiny black seeds.

name: tomato
clue: I am red and round. People put me in salad.
clue3: People make ketchup from me.

name: avocado
clue: I am green. I have a big round seed in the middle.
clue3: I am soft and creamy. People make guacamole from me.

name: olive
clue: I am small and green. People make oil from me.
clue3: I can be green or black. People put me on pizza.

name: papaya
clue: I am orange inside with many black seeds.
clue3: I am long and orange. I am soft and sweet.

name: durian
clue: I have big spikes and a very strong smell.
clue3: I am called the king of fruits in Indonesia. Some people love my smell.

name: rambutan
clue: I am red and hairy. I am white and sweet inside.
clue3: My name comes from "rambut", the Indonesian word for hair.

name: mangosteen
clue: I am dark purple outside and white inside.
clue3: I am called the queen of fruits. I have a green cap on top.

name: snake fruit
clue: My brown skin looks like snake skin.
clue3: In Indonesia I am called salak. I am sweet and crunchy.

name: jackfruit
clue: I am very big and green. I am yellow inside.
clue3: I am the biggest tree fruit. In Indonesia I am called nangka.

name: guava
clue: I am green outside and pink inside.
clue3: In Indonesia I am called jambu biji. I am full of vitamin C.

name: dragon fruit
clue: I am pink outside and white inside with black seeds.
clue3: My skin has green tips like flames. In Indonesia I am buah naga.

name: starfruit
clue: When you cut me, I look like a star.
clue3: I am yellow and juicy. I have five sides.

name: lychee
clue: I am small and red. I am white and juicy inside.
clue3: I have bumpy red skin. I taste sweet like flowers.

name: pomegranate
clue: I am red. I have many small red seeds inside.
clue3: I have a little crown. My seeds look like red jewels.

name: plum
clue: I am small, round, and purple.
clue3: I am juicy. When I am dried, I become a prune.

name: fig
clue: I am purple outside and pink inside.
clue3: I am soft and full of tiny seeds. I grow in warm places.

name: raspberry
clue: I am a small red berry made of tiny balls.
clue3: I am soft and red. I am empty in the middle.

name: blackberry
clue: I am a small dark purple berry.
clue3: I grow on a bush with thorns. I am almost black.

name: passion fruit
clue: I am purple outside. I am yellow with seeds inside.
clue3: My skin gets wrinkly when I am ripe. I am sour and sweet.

name: grapefruit
clue: I look like a big orange. I am pink inside.
clue3: I am big and juicy and a little bitter.

name: persimmon
clue: I am orange and I have green leaves on top.
clue3: In Indonesia I am called kesemek. I am soft and sweet.

name: apricot
clue: I am small and orange. I look like a little peach.
clue3: I am soft and orange. People dry me as a snack.

name: lime
clue: I am small, green, and sour.
clue3: I am a little green fruit. People squeeze me on food.
